Bei uns passiert jeden Tag etwas

jobs.title: Senior Director, Digital Marketing
jobs.description: The Opportunity   Digital marketing has been fundamentally restructured by AI — and we need a leader who doesn't just understand that shift, but is actively shaping it. This is not a role for someone catching up; it's for someone who's already operating in the new paradigm.   As Senior Director of Digital Marketing, you will own AvePoint's end-to-end digital presence and performance — from how we're discovered by AI answer engines to how we convert pipeline on the website. You'll lead SEO/GEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), paid media, and web conversion strategy, building a fully AI-powered digital org that stays ahead of the curve on every front.   What You'll Own
jobs.why: This is an extremely senior leadership role in digital marketing, demanding strategic oversight and experience far beyond Anas's early-career, hands-on creative skills.
jobs.proposal_opener: While my experience is hands-on creative strategy, I'm already shaping how AI transforms ad production. Let's discuss how my innovative approach can support your digital marketing vision.
jobs.flags: Extremely senior leadership role, position as eager junior
jobs.summary: This position is for a Senior Director to lead and shape the company's digital marketing strategy, especially in the context of AI's transformation of the field. It requires a visionary leader who is actively adapting to new digital paradigms.
